# New-ZbxReport

## SYNOPSIS

Creates a scheduled report.

## SYNTAX

```
New-ZbxReport [[-Name] <string>] [-UserId <ulong>] [-Description <string>] [-Status <ZabbixReportStatus>] [-DashboardId <ulong>] [-Period <ZabbixReportPeriod>] [-Cycle <ZabbixReportCycle>] [-Weekdays <int>] [-StartTime <TimeOnly>] [-ActiveSince <DateOnly>] [-ActiveTill <DateOnly>] [-Subject <string>] [-Message <string>] [-User <ZabbixReportUserRequest[]>] [-UserGroup <ZabbixReportUserGroupRequest[]>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A scheduled report sends a PDF of a dashboard by email to users and user groups, daily, weekly, monthly or yearly. The New-ZbxReport cmdlet sends report.create with one request field per parameter, then reads the new scheduled report back with report.get and writes it. The server requires -Name and -DashboardId; -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name and wins over a parameter. -WhatIf shows what would be created, and the command needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Create a scheduled report

```powershell
New-ZbxReport -Name 'Weekly ops summary' -DashboardId (Get-ZbxDashboard -Name 'Ops overview').DashboardId -Cycle Weekly -Weekdays 1 -User @{ userid = (Get-ZbxUser -Name 'Admin').UserId }
```

Creates a scheduled report named Weekly ops summary. -Weekdays is a bit set of the days a weekly report goes out, 1 for Monday to 64 for Sunday; the command writes the new report, read back from the server.

## INPUTS

- `ulong`: Bound to -UserId (ByPropertyName), -DashboardId (ByPropertyName).
- `string`: Bound to -Name (ByPropertyName), -Description (ByPropertyName), -Subject (ByPropertyName), -Message (ByPropertyName). Text.
- `ZabbixReportStatus`: Bound to -Status (ByPropertyName). The report status values: ZBX_REPORT_STATUS_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ZabbixReportPeriod`: Bound to -Period (ByPropertyName). The report period values: ZBX_REPORT_PERIOD_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ZabbixReportCycle`: Bound to -Cycle (ByPropertyName). The report cycle values: ZBX_REPORT_CYCLE_* in defines.inc.php.
- `int`: Bound to -Weekdays (ByPropertyName). A number.
- `TimeOnly`: Bound to -StartTime (ByPropertyName).
- `DateOnly`: Bound to -ActiveSince (ByPropertyName), -ActiveTill (ByPropertyName).
- `ZabbixReportUserRequest[]`: Bound to -User (ByPropertyName). users of a ZabbixReportCreateRequest.
- `ZabbixReportUserGroupRequest[]`: Bound to -UserGroup (ByPropertyName). user_groups of a ZabbixReportCreateRequest.
- `PSObject`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Each object as the API answers it.
